data.label: Cryptography & PKI (AES, RSA, ECC)
data.description: Master symmetric encryption (AES-256-GCM), asymmetric encryption (RSA, Elliptic Curve), HMAC signatures, and digital certificate chains.
data.codeSnippet:
# AES-GCM Encryption in Python Cryptography
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
import os

key = AESGCM.generate_key(bit_length=256)
aesgcm = AESGCM(key)
nonce = os.urandom(12)
ciphertext = aesgcm.encrypt(nonce, b"Secret Payload", None)
